build_dataset: build a dataset for CIFAR100, ImageNet, FLOWERS, iNaturalist 2018, or iNaturalist 2019 using build_dataset
build_transform: build a train or eval image transform pipeline with augmentation, resize, and normalization using build_transform
create_INatDataset: create an iNaturalist dataset instance from JSON annotations with a specified taxonomy category using INatDataset
review_INatDataset_init: review the INatDataset class constructor to understand how it parses JSON files and maps categories to targets
test_build_dataset: test the build_dataset function with different dataset types and argparse configurations
